Definition: plural of an apparently primary word (properly, meaning very many); ten thousand; by extension, innumerably many:--ten thousand.
BiblicalUsage: Myrioi means ten thousand — a servant owes his lord ten thousand talents, Paul says though ye have ten thousand instructors in Christ, yet have ye not many fathers, and he would rather speak five words with understanding than ten thousand words in an unknown tongue.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the ten thousand is the number for 'more than you can pay': the debt no servant can settle, and the words no one can understand.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
